designs.notes: New design for the walking route to the exit, in the 400 x 600 column format of handbook 4.7 and 4.8: gradient face, white bubble (py-atom-shape-bubble-solid at the bubble position of py-comp-bord-picto-bubble-face), navy walking figure and navy route arrow, caption in two lines at the caption position and size of 4.7. The figure always walks towards the arrow (mirrored for links). Wayfinding only: it does not replace the green escape route signs (NEN-EN-ISO 7010, NEN 6088).
